All 7 tests pass. The three bugs fixed were:

1. **`overlaps`**: Changed `<=` to `<` so touching intervals (e.g., `(540, 600)` and `(600, 660)`) are not considered overlapping.
2. **`merge_intervals`**: Changed `start < merged[-1][1]` to `start <= merged[-1][1]` so touching intervals are also merged. Also removed in-place `.sort()` call that mutated the argument.
3. **`find_free_slots`**: Changed `>` to `>=` for the min_len check (gap of exactly min_len is valid), and added trailing gap logic after the loop to capture free time after the last busy interval up to `day_end`.
